ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), CASE(StageName, "Qualification", 0, "Needs Analysis", 1, "Proposal", 2, "Negotiation", 3, "Closed Won", 4, -1 ) < CASE(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Qualification", 0, "Needs Analysis", 1, "Proposal", 2, "Negotiation", 3, "Closed Won", 4, -1 ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Stage cannot be moved backward. The new stage must come after the current stage in the sales process.
